ideas.what: Characterization of complete 2-dimensional factorial (UFD) local rings with algebraically closed residue field (char ≠ 2,3,5): exactly the E8 singularity z^2+y^3+x^5=0
ideas.modern_name: Lipman's theorem / factoriality of E8; class group of rational singularities
ideas.usually_credited_to: J. Lipman (1969); analytic case Brieskorn (1967/68), with the topological interpretation via Mumford (1961) and the Poincaré sphere
ideas.where_published: Lipman, Publ. Math. IHES 36 (1969), §25, Theorem 25.1 and Remark 25.2

ideas.what: Comparison of factoriality of the henselization vs the completion
ideas.modern_name: Henselian vs complete UFD descent (Mori, Danilov, Lipman)
ideas.where_published: Lipman 1969; related factoriality results in SGA 2 (Grothendieck–Samuel style)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a misfiled, upside-down page from Lipman's published IHES paper, not Grothendieck's own work. Its content is a well-known, properly credited theorem. Its only interest is archival: a copy of Lipman's preprint sits among Grothendieck's motive notes.
transcription_corrections: Page is rotated 180° and is typewritten (Lipman, IHES 36, p. 159), not a Grothendieck manuscript.
Hats are omitted in places: (i) should read 'The completion R̂ is factorial', (i)' reads 'R̂ is normal', and (iv) reads 'R̂ ≅ S/(u^2+v^3+w^5)'.
Archivist's pencil mark '11' (page number) appears at the bottom left of the image.
